falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: Ice adhesion fails and accreted ice sheds from the rotating blade, restoring the clean aerodynamic profile and winter power output, with no externally exposed heaters or coatings to be eroded by salt  (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Install a closed-loop heated-liquid circuit inside the offshore blade: corrosion-resistant (duplex stainless or polymer-lined) channels bonded to the spar/shell, a reservoir plus heater and pump in the hub/nacelle, and a salt-sealed rotary coupling; thermostatically cycle the fluid so heat conducts outward through the shell to melt the ice layer at the leading edge.
falsification_contract.CONTROL: the physics stage's executed BASELINE_COMPARISON arm (lifecycle verdict BEATS_BASELINE) — the baseline the candidate was measured against in the same evaluation
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: In a climatic wind tunnel, accrete glaze ice on a blade section at -10 C with salt-spray preconditioning, run the internal heated-liquid loop at 25 m/s wind, and log ice-shed time, surface temperature distribution, and post-test fluid leakage/corrosion after 100 salt-fog cycles versus an unheated control.
